entries.name: C1 persistent-Laplacian non-harmonic spectrum — full Markov-1 null battery
entries.objective: Test whether the persistent-Laplacian non-harmonic spectrum (Fiedler curve lambda1(t)) of the observed BHPS 9-state employment-state transition graph differs significantly from a Markov-1 null distribution (B=1000), via the Integrated Fiedler Area (IFA) statistic and pointwise BH-FDR comparison at each of the 35 filtration thresholds. Discovery Harness candidate; no paper number assigned. A POSITIVE result licenses only a further analysis pre-registration, not manuscript text.

metric_space.data: 9-state directed BHPS employment-state transition graph (EL,EM,EH,UL,UM,UH,IL,IM,IH), n=8509 spanning-sample trajectories
metric_space.backend_note: PETLS verified importable and cross-validated bit-for-bit against the numpy fallback on this exact substrate at all 35 thresholds, 2026-07-07 (commit on pipe/c1-pl-module). Worker must re-verify PETLS_AVAILABLE at run start and record which backend ran; do not assume.

null_model.operation: Markov-1 shuffle: estimate the first-order transition matrix and initial-state distribution from all 8509 observed trajectories, generate synthetic trajectories of matching lengths, rebuild the 9x9 count matrix and float32 distance matrix from the SYNTHETIC trajectories, then compute the 35-step Fiedler curve on that null graph. Same estimation approach as trajectory_tda/topology/permutation_nulls.py _markov_shuffle (order=1), adapted to skip re-embedding (the null only needs the raw synthetic state sequences to rebuild the transition graph, not an ngram embedding).
null_model.invariance_requirement: The null operation MUST perturb the object the Fiedler curve is computed on (the transition-count-derived distance matrix), not merely a downstream scalar. Run the null-model-invariance-audit check before launching B=1000: confirm that at least one null draw's distance matrix differs from the observed D, and that IFA(null) varies across draws (non-degenerate null).

primary_statistic.name: Integrated Fiedler Area (IFA)
primary_statistic.definition: IFA = sum_t lambda1(t) * delta_t (trapezoidal rule over the 35 thresholds)
primary_statistic.p_value: p = (r + 1) / (B + 1), r = count(null IFA >= observed IFA); one-sided (testing for a LARGER observed spectrum than the null predicts)

secondary_statistic.name: Pointwise threshold comparison
secondary_statistic.definition: At each of the 35 thresholds t, fraction of null draws with lambda1_null(t) >= lambda1_obs(t); Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha=0.05 across the 35 thresholds

subgroup_extension.condition: only if IFA p < 0.05 on the full sample
subgroup_extension.note: exploratory signal characterisation only; does not change the primary decision

key_params.backend_used: RECORD AT RUN TIME (petls | petls-pytorch | numpy-schur-scratch)

decision_rule.positive: IFA p < 0.05 AND >= 1 pointwise threshold survives BH-FDR -> PROMOTE: draft full analysis plan for a Track-C flagship paper (requires a new pre-registration; no prose yet)
decision_rule.marginal: (IFA p < 0.05 but no pointwise threshold survives BH-FDR) OR (IFA p >= 0.05 but >= 5 pointwise thresholds survive BH-FDR) -> surface as a User-decision point: targeted follow-up or PARK
decision_rule.negative: IFA p >= 0.05 AND no pointwise threshold survives BH-FDR -> KILL/PARK; write [NEGATIVE] vault note; do NOT rescue with a post-hoc spectral summary variant without a new pre-registration

outcome_to_prose.positive: No paper prose. Requires a separate full-analysis pre-registration specifying the complete observed-vs-Markov-null comparison at subgroup level, NS-SEC stratification design, publication venue, and contribution narrative.
outcome_to_prose.marginal: Present measured IFA and BH-FDR table to User; User decides on a targeted follow-up (different null model, different filtration, subgroup-only) or PARK.
outcome_to_prose.negative: Record exact IFA p-value and pointwise survival table in a [NEGATIVE] vault note. Update backlog C1 entry to KILL/PARK.

hard_non_goals: Do not scale to L=5000 embedding infrastructure — the substrate is the 9-node transition graph throughout.
Do not draft paper prose regardless of outcome.
Do not add epsilon tolerance anywhere in the float32 threshold comparisons.
Do not run the B=1000 battery outside an approved, dispatched Worker session — this pre-registration authorizes dispatch preparation, not execution.
